author: architecture
scope: Official Git inspection, paginated branch selection, explicit new/existing branch creation, explicit existing-tree adoption, persisted location list, fresh check before use, revision-checked metadata-only forgetting.
Known operation ID prepare/start/status/cancel/recheck/acknowledge; no automatic rerun of Git after missing IPC receipt, crash or metadata uncertainty.
One current intent plus necessary location/material metadata in Farfold settings; no Agent config/history/loop changes and no persistent process or event ledger.
Actual quit/save, pre-renderer native exit, clear/restart and managed-update worktree admission wiring.

implementation.inspection: Canonical selected root, canonical main repositoryRoot, common Git directory and directory identity; exact selected OID; supported Git metadata is read without an index/status rewrite. Bare/unborn/detached/locked/partial-clone/enabled-sparse constraints are explicit.
implementation.checkout: Capture effective selected-tree attributes through an isolated temporary official Git context and index. Share source objects read-only, never source helper configuration. Copy only normalized checkout scalars and exact effective attributes. Register with official worktree add --no-checkout, then materialize the prechecked immutable OID and publish only the new linked-tree index. Recheck source, parent, target, registration, branch and OID. Never overwrite the original index or worktree.
implementation.helpers: Every owned Git call disables hooks, fsmonitor, automatic maintenance/GC, credential helpers and lazy promisor fetch. GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 is the official fixed command environment, not an application flag or Agent environment. Existing branch ref drift is rejected before materialization; no source-config filter runs during registration.
implementation.attributes: Global/system/info/selected-tree precedence is captured; linked-tree info location comes from official --git-path. Effective filters are rejected while unrelated registered git-lfs/filter drivers do not reject ordinary repositories. Git --type=bool normalizes legal bool aliases; autocrlf=input and safecrlf=warn remain explicit enums.
implementation.process: Each command owns a dedicated process group and tempfile output. Direct child is reaped; same-group surviving descendants prevent success and retain admission until group disappearance. Cancel/timeout/oversized stdout or stderr never reports ready. Dropping an IPC receiver does not restart Git.
implementation.persistence: Immediate SQLite raw-value CAS plus post-commit exact readback. Persist intent before side effects; final storage failure preserves actual files and prior persisted target, reports unknown, and only explicitly retries metadata. Same-ID changed input conflicts; cold IDs from current intent, saved locations and unresolved materials cannot execute again.
implementation.unknown: Cold settled=true means this instance has no worker, not that a prior process stopped. Explicit acknowledgment preserves target/material identity and leaves state unknown; it does not create a verified Location. In-flight work cannot be acknowledged or bypassed by exit confirmation. Settled storage uncertainty permits explicit risk-confirmed exit without pretending persistence succeeded.
implementation.commands: Main-window caller gate; fixed {code} failures, validated tagged DTOs, no raw Git stderr surfaced. The lib.rs registration also includes the parent-requested official async-task command, whose implementation/test ownership is separate.

boundaries: No formal app rebuild/install/launch, real Agent, credentials, actual user repository or real user database touched by this owner; all Git and SQLite tests use disposable owned fixtures.

No Windows validation. Unsupported platform/Git surfaces retain ordinary-folder fallback. The local Git supports GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH environment but not the newer --no-lazy-fetch CLI; only the environment is used and its local behavior is actually proven.
Cold current-instance absence is not proof an old process stopped; there is no durable process ledger and acknowledgement does not say otherwise.

Same-process-group disappearance is checked; escaped process groups are not claimed tracked. Executable repository helpers are excluded from supported checkout, and tests do not certify every OS/network configuration.
Because official check-attr makes -filter and filter=unset ambiguous, a configured driver literally named unset conservatively blocks both rather than silently omitting a transform.
Safe physical worktree removal/archive and broader H15 maintenance remain pending. This slice forgets metadata only; no directory, ignored file, branch or commit deletion.
Large supported limits are bounds, not a throughput benchmark. Full-repository engineering and installed product acceptance belong to root subsequent checkpoints.
